notes: bot v5: (1) empty-search retry — when the search API returns an empty result set (backend gateway wobble can yield [] instead of an error; production misfire 2026-10-31 23:24, a search for a title with plenty of results was declared not-found), the bot re-runs the search up to 2 more times at ~6s gaps before replying not-found; a throw still yields the usual service-error reply. (2) daily-digest poster — between 21:00 and 23:59 Asia/Shanghai (fixed +8h math, chroot TZ may be UTC) the bot polls the release mirrors every ~3 min for digest/digest-YYYY-MM-DD.txt (today only), posts its content verbatim as one message to group 873487569, and writes a digest-posted-YYYY-MM-DD marker next to bot.js (re-checked right before sending) so each date is posted at most once; fetch failures stay silent. scripts stays v4: stop and OTA bot-restart sweep /proc by exact argv (watchdogs first, TERM then KILL) and kill orphaned bot.js processes that pidfiles/process groups miss; the updater sweeps, then relaunches exactly one watchdog. bot also keeps v4 behaviors (single-instance lock + message_id dedup + video-over-novel pick).
